newsitem.title: UK: BOXING-LEWIS TO DEFEND AGAINST AKINWANDE.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-LEWIS TO DEFEND AGAINST AKINWANDE.

text.p: World Boxing Council(WBC) heavyweight champion Lennox Lewis will defend his title against fellow Briton Henry Akinwande in Lake Tahoe, Nevada, on July 12, Lewis's camp said on Tuesday.

Ed Robinson, a spokesman for Lewis's manager Frank Maloney, confirmed that the fight had been set for that date in the Nevada resort instead of Atlantic City or London, both of which has been mooted but ruled out as the venue for the bout.
Akinwande formerly held the World Boxing Organisation (WBO) title and made two defences, but relinquished it to concentrate on his bid for Lewis's crown.
